subject: Upcoming Charitable Foundation Endowment – Request for a Meeting
body:
Dear Mr. Pemberton-Hale,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to follow up regarding the planned initial endowment of USD 12,000,000 for your charitable foundation, expected in January 2027. As we look ahead to this important milestone, I would welcome the opportunity to review the foundation's overall portfolio structure with you, including the current allocation of 24.0% to Global gold across three positions and one instrument type.

I believe it would be valuable to discuss how these elements align with the foundation's broader objectives and to address any questions you may have as the endowment date approaches.

Could we arrange a meeting at your convenience in the coming weeks? I am happy to accommodate a time and format that suits you best, whether in person or via video call.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
